one_liner: Create an app quickly, but API access requires scope approval with an unknown wait time.

start_today.summary: You can register an OAuth app and request scopes today, but no API access is granted until those scopes are explicitly approved by Calendly.
limits_before_approval: No API access is granted until scopes are explicitly requested and approved [s5].
Certain API features (e.g., some compliance endpoints) may require the connecting user to have a paid Calendly plan [s2].

composio.note: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for Calendly, allowing developers to launch immediately. A custom app is only needed for branding, extra scopes, dedicated rate limits, faster trigger polling, or self-hosted instances.

prerequisites.detail: Required to access the Calendly Developer tools and register an OAuth app.
All developers must have a privacy policy that accurately describes data usage and complies with legal and consent requirements.

steps.text: Develop an industry-standard privacy policy that accurately describes data usage and meets legal requirements.
Ensure your application adheres to Calendly brand guidelines and provides a good user experience.
Access Calendly Developer tools from the Profile menu in your Calendly account.
Create a new OAuth app on the 'OAuth apps' tab.
Provide a unique 'App name' and at least one 'Redirect URI'.
Select an environment type: 'Sandbox' for development/testing or 'Production' for real users.
Ensure production Redirect URIs use HTTPS; Sandbox apps also allow HTTP URIs on localhost.
Explicitly request all necessary authorization scopes for your application's required API access.
Await approval for the requested scopes, as no API access is granted until they are approved.
Implement retry logic for API requests, as Calendly advises due to undocumented rate limits.
Include clear instructions within your application on how to connect Calendly and provide customer support information.

scopes.purpose: Grants read access to meeting recap resources, including transcripts. Required for Notetaker webhook subscriptions.
Grants permission to update and delete meeting recap resources.
Define the permissions an application requests, controlling read or modify access to various Calendly resources.

approval.trigger: Explicitly requesting authorization scopes for your newly created OAuth app, as no API access is granted until approved.
reviewers_check: Adherence to developer policy, including having an industry-standard privacy policy [s6, s10].
Accurate description of data usage and compliance with legal and consent requirements [s6, s10].
Good user experience that adds value to users [s6].
Prohibition from compromising security, providing fraudulent access, or transmitting malicious code [s6].
Inclusion of instructions on how to connect Calendly and customer support information [s6].
common_rejections: Failure to meet developer policy requirements, such as an inadequate privacy policy or poor user experience [s6, s10].

blockers.blocker: No API access is granted until scopes are explicitly requested and approved.
blockers.fix: Request all necessary scopes during app registration and await Calendly's approval.

blockers.blocker: Certain API features (e.g., some compliance endpoints) may require the connecting user to have a paid Calendly plan.
blockers.fix: Inform users of plan requirements for specific features within your application.

blockers.blocker: Failure to adhere to Calendly's Developer Policy, including privacy policy, brand guidelines, and security requirements.
blockers.fix: Ensure full compliance with all developer policies before and during app operation.

agent_can: Draft privacy policy content based on data usage.
Select minimal required scopes for initial functionality.
Prepare responses for potential review questions.
Check redirect URI settings for correctness.
Run a test OAuth flow once credentials exist.
you_must: Create a Calendly account and access Developer tools.
Provide legal attestations for your privacy policy and data handling.
Make the final submission of the OAuth app.
Provide customer support information for your application.

agent.discovery_notes: OAuth does not use granular scopes; an access token can access everything the user can. A free Calendly account works for testing. Webhooks and the Scheduling API are available on all Calendly plans, including Free, but free plans are subject to API rate limits.
